facts.statement: Fossil remains consisting of a skull with a jaw have been found in the Adamantina Formation of Brazil.
facts.quote: Sus restos fósiles, un cráneo con mandíbula, han aparecido en la Formación Adamantina de Brasil.

facts.statement: Gondwanasuchus belongs to the family Baurusuchidae.
Gondwanasuchus is classified within the subfamily Pissarrachampsinae.
Recent studies concluded that Gondwanasuchus is a juvenile specimen of a larger Baurusuchid species, making it a nomen dubium.
facts.quote: It was recently concluded to be a juvenile specimen of a bigger Baurusuchid species, and therefore a nomen dubium

facts.statement: Gondwanasuchus lived during the Campanian to Maastrichtian stages, between 83.6 and 66 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Campanian to Maastrichtian (83.6 to 66 million years ago)

facts.statement: The genus Gondwanasuchus was described by Marinho, Iori, Carvalho, and Vasconcelos in 2013.
The type species of the genus Gondwanasuchus is Gondwanasuchus scabrosus.

rejected.statement: Gondwanasuchus is an extinct genus of baurusuchid crocodyliforms found in the Late Cretaceous Adamantina Formation of Brazil.
rejected.quote: Gondwanasuchus is an extinct genus of baurusuchid crocodyliforms from the Late Cretaceous Adamantina Formation of Brazil.
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'Gondwanasuchus is an extinct genus of baurusuchid crocodyliforms'
